trip_identity: Tripsy original external_trip_id preserved; keep all variants isolated

quote_schema.source_and_scope: search property quote, NOT full room-level checkout
quote_schema.person_night: display only, not budget ledger value
quote_schema.price_refresh: new quote on exact date+party+bed configuration+taxes, do not overwrite historical quote
quote_schema.date_exclusivity: quotes for September 2027 must not be used for August 2027
quote_schema.eligibility: 3-person group survey not applicable to Switzerland 4-person variant

budget_rules: use integer minor currency units or decimal
each shared expense stored ONCE with party amount
allocate remainder cents deterministically by stable traveller id
alternative candidate must not become selected without explicit user action
do not count free Interrail pass unless eligibility and actual grant confirmed
N/A prices are null, never zero
survey_rules: for conflict offer optional parallel plans and rotate preferences
kitchen not explicitly required by survey
C EUR30 plus/minus not a strict cap

travel_rule_night_train.flexipass: departure day only when direct overnight service; after-midnight new train uses extra day; arrival date within pass validity

personal_source_data: 3 aliases only; do not expose emails, provider reservation codes, home addresses
reconciliation: match by external IDs and same variant, flag fuzzy matches do not delete
